title: Finding Louie Tio on London Avenue
summary: Harold says Lorenzo was his teacher; they work out Louie Tio is his brother, listed under Long, and Russell plans to find him.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth
